scope: library only; original driver and shared IO unchanged
claude_review_reused: Audit/matching-flow-optimization-fable-2026-11-16.json preferred_max_flow_bipartite reviews exactly this library. Other judge mains are outside optimization scope.

manifest.scope: non-Library-Checker; library-only optimization. Existing driver/main and common IO are unchanged.

independent_reference.grid: Python bipartite augmenting-path reference; compare optimum and validate every arrow, pair, blocked cell, boundary and tile count
independent_reference.yuki: Python matrix Edmonds-Karp with independent integer residual capacities; compare requested work and success word

measurement.ordering: old/new execution order shuffled per paired trial
measurement.metrics: whole-process wall time; getrusage user+system time includes IO, construction, solving, output and destruction
measurement.notes: short process startup, ASLR, scheduling and concurrent-system variation remain; all outputs independently checked

manifest.decision: Mixed performance is retained as evidence, not a claim of universal speedup. The random 0.5-open grid regression remains reproducible; the random 0.8-open grid improves. No case-specific implementation heuristic was added.
limitations: Finite local correctness checks are not an online AC verdict.
The maximum matching layout can differ; both layouts were validated rather than requiring identical output bytes.
Seven-run aggregate and twenty-one-run followup are separate measurements; do not pool their wall times across changing runtime conditions.

summary.scope: same driver and common IO; only Max_Flow.cpp body changes; whole process timings include IO, construction, solving, output and destruction
summary.limitations: seven paired runs; small-case process startup and scheduling noise remain; no online AC claimed
summary.grid_reference: independent Python bipartite matching plus every arrow/blocked cell checked
summary.capacity_reference: independent Python Edmonds-Karp with a work limit; official input constraints checked
